title: Namespace Isolation
description: Namespace Isolation is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Gives each tenant a private namespace nothing else can see. Resources are tagged by tenant at creation; queries without the tenant tag see nothing. It takes tenant id and produces isolated view. Tunable parameters: per resource. Guarantee: cross-tenant reads always fail.

fields.mechanism: Resources are tagged by tenant at creation; queries without the tenant tag see nothing.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Network Segmentation
description: Network Segmentation is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Segments tenant networks so traffic never crosses. Each tenant gets virtual networks with deny-by-default rules between them. It takes tenants and produces segments. Tunable parameters: deny default. Guarantee: segments never allow cross traffic.

fields.mechanism: Each tenant gets virtual networks with deny-by-default rules between them.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Encryption Per Tenant
description: Encryption Per Tenant is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Encrypts each tenant's data with its own keys. Data keys are per-tenant and wrapped by the tenant master key; rotation is independent. It takes tenants and produces key sets. Tunable parameters: per tenant. Guarantee: one tenant's key never decrypts another's.

fields.mechanism: Data keys are per-tenant and wrapped by the tenant master key; rotation is independent.
fields.guarantees: one tenant's key never decrypts another's

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Quota Boundaries
description: Quota Boundaries is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Enforces hard resource quotas per tenant. CPU, memory, and storage quotas are enforced at admission; over-quota requests wait. It takes quotas and produces enforcement. Tunable parameters: per tenant. Guarantee: a tenant never borrows another's quota.

fields.mechanism: CPU, memory, and storage quotas are enforced at admission; over-quota requests wait.
fields.guarantees: a tenant never borrows another's quota

title: Noisy-Neighbor Guards
description: Noisy-Neighbor Guards is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Protects tenants from each other's spikes. Per-tenant rate limits and CPU shares isolate performance; hogs are throttled. It takes usage and produces throttles. Tunable parameters: per tenant. Guarantee: throttling never touches the victim.

fields.mechanism: Per-tenant rate limits and CPU shares isolate performance; hogs are throttled.

title: Audit Per Tenant

Each tenant's events write to its own log stream; admins see only with tenant consent. It takes events and produces tenant logs. Tunable parameters: per tenant. Guarantee: logs never mix tenants.

fields.mechanism: Each tenant's events write to its own log stream; admins see only with tenant consent.

Guarantee: writes never leave the pinned regions.

Guarantee: wiped data is never recoverable.

Guarantee: sharing never exceeds the grant.

title: Isolation Testing
description: Isolation Testing is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Continuously tests that isolation actually holds. Probes attempt cross-tenant reads hourly; any success pages security immediately. It takes probes and produces test results. Tunable parameters: hourly. Guarantee: a failed probe always pages.

title: Metadata Privacy
description: Metadata Privacy is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Keeps tenant metadata — names, counts — private too. Metadata queries are tenant-scoped; aggregate stats need k-anonymity. It takes metadata and produces scoped answers. Tunable parameters: k≥5. Guarantee: small tenants are never identifiable.

fields.mechanism: Metadata queries are tenant-scoped; aggregate stats need k-anonymity.

title: Key Rotation

New keys encrypt new data while old keys decrypt old; rotation completes in the background. It takes keys and produces rotated keys. Tunable parameters: background. Guarantee: rotation never locks out a tenant.

fields.mechanism: New keys encrypt new data while old keys decrypt old; rotation completes in the background.

title: Incident Containment
description: Incident Containment is a security ability in the Multi-Tenant Isolation Policies database. Contains a compromised tenant without touching others. Compromise of one tenant triggers its network and key quarantine only. It takes incident and produces quarantine. Tunable parameters: per tenant. Guarantee: quarantine never spreads.

fields.mechanism: Compromise of one tenant triggers its network and key quarantine only.

title: Isolation Scorecards

Checks — encryption, segmentation, quotas — roll into a 0–100 score with fixes. It takes checks and produces score. Tunable parameters: monthly. Guarantee: scores always list the failing checks.
